input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 expressly states that no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies and that Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, with non-ordering not treated as a breach or shortfall — both preferred elements are met on the face of the document. Section 7.1 reinforces this by barring any unidentified minimum-use charge, and Section 12.3 confirms Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment. The only "shortfall" mechanic (Sections 22.1–22.2, audit of licensed quantities) is a usage true-up for actual over-consumption, not a take-or-pay commitment, and there are no volume caps on Customer usage. No redline required.
